name: Condemios de Arriba (Spain)
description: Red field with a white horizontal stripe across the fly half charged with the crowned municipal arms of Condemios de Arriba (a tower and a tree on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Condemios de Arriba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: horizontal stripe across the centre of the fly half
